class OnePhonon.__init__: Constructor that initializes the OnePhonon model with PDB path, sampling parameters, and GNM parameters. Must convert all core data structures to PyTorch tensors for differentiation.
class OnePhonon._setup: Core setup function that initializes reciprocal space grid, resolution mask, and sets up the crystal object. Initializes tensors for computations.
class OnePhonon._setup_phonons: Sets up phonon calculations: initializes k-vector grid, dynamical matrices, and eigenvalue arrays as tensors.
class OnePhonon._build_A: Builds the displacement projection matrix (A matrix) that projects rigid-body displacements to individual atomic displacements.
class OnePhonon._build_M: Builds the mass matrix for the normal mode analysis, projects the all-atom mass matrix using the A matrix.
class OnePhonon._build_M_allatoms: Creates the atomic mass matrix from element weights. This is diagonal with atomic masses.
class OnePhonon._project_M: Projects the all-atom mass matrix to rigid-body degrees of freedom using A matrix projections.
class OnePhonon._build_kvec_Brillouin: Computes all k-vectors and their norms in the first Brillouin zone by regularly sampling reciprocal space.
class OnePhonon._center_kvec: Helper function for k-vector centering within Brillouin zone. Applies periodic boundary conditions.
class OnePhonon._at_kvec_from_miller_points: Maps Miller indices to reciprocal space indices. Used to find indices of all q-vectors that are k-vector away from Miller indices.
class OnePhonon.compute_gnm_phonons: Computes phonon modes from the Gaussian Network Model (GNM) at each k-vector in the Brillouin zone.
class OnePhonon.compute_hessian: Builds the Hessian matrix for the elastic network model of the crystal, capturing interatomic force constants.
class OnePhonon.compute_covariance_matrix: Computes the covariance matrix for atomic displacements, using the GNM Hessian and scaling to match experimental ADPs.
class OnePhonon.apply_disorder: Main computation function that produces diffuse intensity by applying the one-phonon approximation to the structure factors.

scatter.py.compute_form_factors: Evaluates atomic form factors at given q-vectors using the parameterized form factor coefficients.
scatter.py.structure_factors_batch: Computes structure factors for a batch of q-vectors, including atomic form factors, phase factors, and thermal displacement factors.
scatter.py.structure_factors: Wrapper that breaks calculation into batches and optionally parallelizes the computation of structure factors.

class GaussianNetworkModel.__init__: Constructor for GNM that sets up atomic interactions with spring constants.
class GaussianNetworkModel._setup_atomic_model: Builds unit cell and nearest neighbors while storing dimensions needed for computation.
class GaussianNetworkModel._setup_gaussian_network_model: Builds interaction pair lists and spring constants for the elastic network.
class GaussianNetworkModel.build_gamma: Creates tensor of spring constants between atom pairs, with different values for intra-ASU vs. inter-ASU interactions.
class GaussianNetworkModel.build_neighbor_list: Uses spatial tree search to identify atom pairs within cutoff distance for elastic interactions.
class GaussianNetworkModel.compute_hessian: Builds the Hessian matrix from interaction pairs and spring constants, encoding force relationships.
class GaussianNetworkModel.compute_K: Computes the dynamical matrix for a given k-vector by summing Hessian blocks with phase factors.
class GaussianNetworkModel.compute_Kinv: Computes the inverse of the dynamical matrix, which relates to atomic displacement correlations.

class AtomicModel._get_xyz_asus: Transforms atomic coordinates using symmetry operations to generate all asymmetric units in the unit cell.
class AtomicModel.flatten_model: Reshapes multi-dimensional tensor arrays to simplify computations.

class Crystal.get_asu_xyz: Returns atomic coordinates for a specific asymmetric unit in a specified unit cell, used in diffuse scattering calculations.

map_utils.py.generate_grid: Creates a grid of q-vectors (or hkl indices) based on desired extents and spacing in reciprocal space.
map_utils.py.get_resolution_mask: Creates boolean mask indicating which grid points are within resolution limits.
map_utils.py.compute_resolution: Calculates the resolution in Angstroms for given Miller indices based on unit cell parameters.
